locations.name: BRGY. SAN ISIDRO
locations.label: SAN ISIDRO
locations.description: Your home barangay on the southwest coast. Pack the emergency go bag and guide your neighbors to the evacuation center before the typhoon arrives.

locations.name: NORTH WEST PLATEAU
locations.label: NW PLATEAU
locations.description: Mountain settlements on fractured ground. Survive the earthquake and the landslide, and follow the strange signal beneath the plateau.

locations.name: CENTRAL TOWN
locations.label: CENTRAL TOWN
locations.description: The island's busy heart. Fire, quakes and floods strike the streets while the city struggles to shelter everyone who remains.

locations.name: THE HARBOR
locations.label: HARBOR
locations.description: Docks and fishing boats trapped between land and sea. Help the harbor folk weather the storm, the flood and the fire.

locations.name: NORTH EAST PLAINS
locations.label: NE PLAINS
locations.description: Wide farmlands beneath a sleeping giant. Protect the farming families and follow the road to the remote research facility.

locations.name: VOLCANO VALLEY
locations.label: VOLCANO VALLEY
locations.description: A steep valley below the volcano. Reach the hidden research complex and learn the truth about the World Engine.

locations.name: MAIN CONTROL ROOM
locations.label: CONTROL ROOM
locations.description: The World Engine's core beneath the crater. Confront the machine and shut it down to end the disasters for good.
